name: Acquisition Review Criteria
description: How the internal review team ranks properties offered to the District. Adjust the weights or add a criterion here — no code change is needed.

criteria.label: Natural resource value
criteria.description: Quality of habitat, water resources, forest or other natural features.

criteria.label: Fit with program goals
criteria.description: How well the property advances an adopted District program.

criteria.label: Connectivity to existing holdings
criteria.description: Whether the property adjoins or links land the District already manages.

criteria.label: Public access potential
criteria.description: Suitability for public use, including road frontage and parking.

criteria.label: Cost relative to value
criteria.description: Asking price measured against appraised or assessed value. Higher score = better value.

criteria.label: Ongoing management burden
criteria.description: Expected cost and complexity of managing the property. Higher score = lower burden.

criteria.label: Environmental and legal risk
criteria.description: Known contamination, encumbrances, easements or access disputes. Higher score = lower risk.

criteria.label: Urgency or threat
criteria.description: Risk of loss to development or other conversion if the District does not act.
